    Contacts and enquiries

    Our Future Student Advisers are here to support you. Visit The University of Western Australia’s main Crawley campus, just 10 minutes from Perth City on the banks of the Swan River, or get in touch with us.

    Contact the Future Students team

    • Call us

      Call us between 8:30am - 5pm, Monday to Friday

      Domestic enquiries: 131 UWA (131 892)

      International enquiries: +61 8 6488 1000

    • Visit us

      Drop in between 9am - 4pm, Monday to Friday,  see above for Dec opening hours

      View the campus map

    • Enquire online

      Send us an online enquiry and we'll get back to you

      Send an enquiry

    • Graduate Research School

      If you are interested in undertaking a PhD at UWA please contact the Graduate Research School to discuss your eligibility, admission requirements and any other questions you may have.

    • Other queries

      For more ways to get in touch, please refer to our general contact information.

    • Chat to an international student

      Talk to real current UWA international students and have your questions answered about student life at UWA and in Perth.

    • Domestic

      Australian citizen / permanent resident of Australia / New Zealand citizen

    • International

      Temporary resident of Australia / permanent resident of New Zealand / resident or citizen of any other country
